techniques: Disks for shrinking or expanding targets

weaknesses: Advanced age limits physical hand-to-hand endurance
Reliance on external particle canisters and suit technology
limitations: Subatomic realm traversal carries extreme environmental risks without a regulator.

characters.summary: Happy Hogan is a former boxer, head of security, and close associate of Tony Stark who relies on basic pugilism, improvised weapons, and occasionally armored suits in confrontations.

mechanisms: Occasional use of powered armor or reinforced security gear

weaknesses: Lacks superhuman durability or powers
Vulnerable to supernatural or high-tier cosmic opponents
limitations: Fights primarily as a standard human without innate supernatural traits

weaknesses: Standard human physical limits

characters.summary: Hela, the Asgardian Goddess of Death, is an immensely powerful conqueror who generates an infinite array of sharp necro-swords, possesses overwhelming Asgardian strength, and draws continuous vitality directly from Asgard.

mechanisms: Near-instantaneous regeneration while connected to Asgard

weaknesses: Power diminishes if severed from the realm of Asgard
Destroying Asgard itself leads to her ultimate defeat
limitations: Power source is tied directly to the physical existence of Asgard

weaknesses: Extreme psychological provocation can disrupt strategic focus
Vulnerable to powerful electrical submission discs
